newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China fixed asset investment up 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China fixed asset investment up 15 pct.

text.p: China's fixed asset investment is forecast to reach 537 billion yuan in the first half of this year, up 15 percent year-on-year, the Financial News said on Tuesday.

Growth in fixed asset investment was seen growing faster in the second quarter compared with the first three months, it said quoting a survey by the Information Department of the State Economic and Trade Commission.
Fixed asset investment rose by 13.9 percent in the first quarter, State Statistical Bureau figures showed.
